channelMetadataRenderer.title: Music Madras
channelMetadataRenderer.description:
Welcome to Music Madras.

Music Madras exists to preserve, document and celebrate Western Classical Music in Chennai-and eventually across India.

Through professional concert recordings, educational content and a growing digital archive, we are creating a living archive of performances, musicians, choirs, orchestras, churches and musical heritage.

We believe every performance leaves behind an acoustic amber-a fleeting moment of music that deserves to be preserved, studied and shared with future generations.

Whether you're a performer, student, educator or music lover, we invite you to join us on this journey.

Website: https://www.musicmadras.com 

Subscribe for concert recordings, educational content, interviews and stories celebrating Western Classical Music.

Preserve. Document. Celebrate.
